full_text_tesim: Common codicological and palaeographical features suggest that the three Hippocratic texts and the two other medical texts in this codex ("Antyllus?, Recipes for different diseases" and "Treatise on medical terms") belonged to the same original manuscript (Rossetto)
Traces of foliation by a later hand on fol. 7r, the same same hand that foliated the UTO Treatise on medical terms, fol. 54v (Rossetto)
